  "outcome_measure": "Response sensitivity (d') calculated from same/different judgments on the top parts of the stimuli",

  "sample_size_total": 22,
  "recruitment_and_incentive": "Allowed 22 people to register in case some might not show up, and stopped data collection after testing all those who did show up",
  "analysis_plan": "A repeated measures analysis of variance (ANOVA) on response sensitivity (d') including factors of alignment, congruency, and task, followed by separate ANOVAs and t-tests for each task condition.",

  other_methods_notes: "Participants performed two composite tasks (one with faces and one with line patterns, order counterbalanced).
